title: objectql: the in-process engine reads `fields: []` as every column while every published projection declaration refuses an empty projection (found on #26954)
body:
Filing gate: ① the in-process engine answers a shape every published declaration now refuses, by widening it. It was measured by the dev on PR #27007 (#26954); see the Acceptance notes there. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ This is not a claim. It has no grade: triage sets the lane and the grade.

**Business reason.** #26817, #26909 and #26954 settled one rule: an empty projection is refused, never read as "every column". The HTTP doors and every published declaration of a read's projection now refuse `[]`, including `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields` once #27007 lands. The in-process engine still reads `fields: []` as every column. A plugin, a hook through `ctx.api`, or any in-process caller that builds an empty projection by mistake gets owner, org and audit columns back silently. That is the widening class #22300 and #7532 closed for other shapes.

## Measured (`origin/main` `3217fc5d`, by the dev on #27007)

- `ObjectQL.find` / `findOne` never parse their options with `EngineQueryOptionsSchema`.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` ~:13563 projects only when `ast.fields.length > 0`, and ~:13573 falls back to `*` on an empty projection.
- So `engine.find(obj, { fields: [] })` returns every column, and the caller is not told.

## Wanted (for triage to grade and route)

Choose one of these, judged against the callers:
- The engine refuses an empty projection with the same refusal the declarations give (a narrowing with a census of in-process callers that pass `[]`).
- Or the engine documents and pins that `[]` means "no projection" and the declarations say why the in-process face differs. This option is weaker, because it keeps two rules.

The dev measured zero in-repo non-test callers that send `fields: []` to an engine query (`git grep` over `packages`, `ui`, `examples`, `apps` and `skills`).

## Dedupe

I ran `search_issues` on this repo for "engine find empty fields projection reads every column". It returned #26954 (the source card, declarations only), #26910 (client call site, closed), and #22300, #7532 and #7589 (other widening shapes, closed). **This card is new.**
